summary: Verified the Panjar Kerja 'History Settlement' Aksi column bug fix. Backend: PNJ-202607-0004 (status Open) now returns all 7 settle_history entries with a round_id via GET /api/cash-advances. DELETE /api/cash-advances/{cid}/settle/{round_id} correctly returns 400 for a Settled panjar (PNJ-202607-0001) and 404 for unknown round_id / unknown panjar. Frontend: logged in as admin, opened History (7) modal for PNJ-202607-0004, and all 7 rows (history-del-0 .. history-del-6) now show enabled Trash action buttons instead of '—'. Delete endpoint destructive path was NOT executed against real data per the request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backfill_settle_round_ids() on startup successfully tagged legacy rounds; verified via API and UI. Settled panjar (e.g. PNJ-202607-0001) is correctly locked (HTTP 400). Did not actually delete any round from production-like data.
rca_of_the_issue: Legacy settle_history entries pre-dated the round_id field; frontend hid Aksi buttons whenever round_id was missing (rendering '—'). Startup self-heal (backfill_settle_round_ids) now assigns a UUID round_id to each legacy round and tags matching journal_entries/awb_costs/fixed_costs so DELETE can reverse cleanly. Verified 7/7 rounds tagged on PNJ-202607-0004 and delete authorization gates behave as expected.
